title: Sign in during checkout
preconditions: A guest Lab session exists and the checkout page is open.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/checkout/ | Submit standard_user and the shared practice password.
expected_result: Checkout becomes available and the guest cart remains unchanged.

title: Reject an incorrect checkout password
preconditions: A guest Lab session exists and the checkout page is open.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/checkout/ | Submit standard_user with an incorrect password.
expected_result: A generic AUTHENTICATION_FAILED message appears and checkout remains locked.

title: Preserve guest cart across login
preconditions: A guest Lab session exists and the checkout page is open.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/checkout/ | Add a product as guest, then sign in from checkout.
expected_result: The same product, quantity, variant, and totals remain in the summary.

title: Require login for order history
preconditions: A guest Lab session exists and the checkout page is open.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/checkout/ | Open order history without an auth session.
expected_result: The page shows an assertion-ready 401 state and a checkout sign-in link.

title: Show authenticated profile
preconditions: A guest Lab session exists and the checkout page is open.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/checkout/ | Sign in as standard_user and open Profile.
expected_result: Username, Customer role, synthetic email, and order count are visible.

title: Load featured products
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/products/ | Open the Store overview.
expected_result: Six or fewer highest-rated in-stock products render with stable IDs.

title: Search catalogue by product name
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/products/ | Enter part of a seeded product name and apply filters.
expected_result: Every rendered card contains the requested search term.

title: Search catalogue by SKU
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/products/ | Enter a seeded SKU and apply filters.
expected_result: The matching product appears without unrelated results.

title: Filter catalogue by category
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/products/ | Choose Electronics and apply filters.
expected_result: Only Electronics cards render and the total count updates.

title: Filter by price range
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/products/ | Set minimum 1000 and maximum 5000, then apply filters.
expected_result: Every product price is within the inclusive range.

title: Filter by minimum rating
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/products/ | Choose 4+ stars and apply filters.
expected_result: No rendered rating is below four.

title: Sort price low to high
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/products/ | Select price low to high.
expected_result: Rendered prices are in ascending order.

title: Sort price high to low
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/products/ | Select price high to low.
expected_result: Rendered prices are in descending order.

title: Navigate catalogue pagination
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/products/ | Load page one, select Next, then Previous.
expected_result: Page labels and products change without duplicate rows.

title: Render no-results state
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/products/ | Search for a string absent from all synthetic products.
expected_result: An explicit empty state replaces product cards without an error.

title: Display product images and alt text
preconditions: Product prd-001 exists in the current store sandbox.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/product/?id=prd-001 | Open a seeded product detail page.
expected_result: Three local images render with product-specific accessible alt text.

title: Display variants
preconditions: Product prd-001 exists in the current store sandbox.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/product/?id=prd-001 | Inspect the Variant control.
expected_result: Published colour and pack choices are available.

title: Add selected quantity and variant
preconditions: Product prd-001 exists in the current store sandbox.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/product/?id=prd-001 | Choose a variant, set quantity two, and add to cart.
expected_result: The cart records the exact product, quantity, and variant.

title: Show stock status
preconditions: Product prd-001 exists in the current store sandbox.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/product/?id=prd-001 | Open an in-stock seeded product.
expected_result: Visible stock text matches the API stock field.

title: Display fictional reviews
preconditions: Product prd-001 exists in the current store sandbox.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/product/?id=prd-001 | Open product details and inspect reviews.
expected_result: Two clearly synthetic reviews show author, rating, and text.

title: Add product from listing
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/cart/ | Select Add to cart on an in-stock listing card.
expected_result: The cart count increments and the item appears in the cart.

title: Update cart quantity
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/cart/ | Change an item quantity from one to three.
expected_result: Line total, item count, subtotal, and total update through the API.

title: Remove cart item
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/cart/ | Select Remove for one cart row.
expected_result: The row disappears and totals are recalculated.

title: Apply TESTHEON10 coupon
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/cart/ | Enter TESTHEON10 and apply.
expected_result: A ten-percent discount is persisted and displayed.

title: Reject expired EXPIRED20 coupon
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/cart/ | Enter EXPIRED20 and apply.
expected_result: The UI displays COUPON_EXPIRED with HTTP 409.

title: Reject unknown INVALID coupon
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/cart/ | Enter INVALID and apply.
expected_result: The UI displays COUPON_UNKNOWN with HTTP 404.

title: Render empty cart state
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/cart/ | Remove every item from the cart.
expected_result: An explicit empty-cart message appears and count becomes zero.

title: Keep cart isolated by session
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/cart/ | Create a second header-mode Lab session and read its cart.
expected_result: The second session has no items from the browser session.

title: Reset store data
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/cart/ | Mutate products, add cart items, create an order, then select Reset store data.
expected_result: Products and orders return to seed while cart, coupon, and pending scenario clear.

title: Load dependent address options
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/checkout/ | Choose India, Maharashtra, then Pune.
expected_result: Country, State, and City enable in order using the locations endpoint.

title: Calculate standard shipping
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/checkout/ | Choose Standard shipping and submit a valid fake checkout.
expected_result: The order includes a ₹99 shipping cost.

title: Calculate express shipping
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/checkout/ | Choose Express shipping and submit a valid fake checkout.
expected_result: The order includes a ₹249 shipping cost.

title: Accept successful fake card
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/checkout/ | Use 4242 4242 4242 4242, 12/30, and 123.
expected_result: A confirmed synthetic order is created with charged=false.

title: Decline fake failure card
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/checkout/ | Use 4000 0000 0000 0002.
expected_result: PAYMENT_DECLINED appears and no order is created.

title: Reject unpublished card number
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/checkout/ | Enter a different numeric card value.
expected_result: PAYMENT_TEST_DATA_INVALID appears and no external request occurs.

title: Validate required address
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/checkout/ | Clear Full name and submit.
expected_result: Native required validation blocks the checkout request.

title: Reject empty cart checkout
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/checkout/ | Remove all items, sign in, and submit checkout through the API.
expected_result: CART_EMPTY returns HTTP 409 and no order is created.

title: Assert checkout request payload
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/checkout/ | Intercept POST /store/checkout and inspect its JSON body.
expected_result: Address, shippingMethod, and fake payment fields match the UI values.

title: Show confirmation order ID
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/checkout/ | Complete a valid fake checkout.
expected_result: Confirmation displays the exact API order ID and no-charge message.

title: List current customer orders
preconditions: standard_user is signed in to the current Lab session.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/orders/ | Complete checkout and open Order history.
expected_result: The new order row shows ID, status, item count, total, and date.

title: Verify UI order through API
preconditions: standard_user is signed in to the current Lab session.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/orders/ | Capture the confirmation order ID and GET /orders/{id}.
expected_result: API fields match the confirmation and submitted cart items.

title: Reflect API order deletion
preconditions: standard_user is signed in to the current Lab session.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/orders/ | DELETE the new order through the API and refresh history.
expected_result: The deleted order row is absent.

title: Keep orders scoped to identity
preconditions: standard_user is signed in to the current Lab session.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/orders/ | Create an order as standard_user and read history as another customer.
expected_result: The second customer cannot see the first customer order.

title: Mock catalogue response
preconditions: The Store overview is open in an isolated Lab session.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/ | Use page.route to fulfil /store/catalog with one known product.
expected_result: The supplied product renders with its mocked values.

title: Modify catalogue response
preconditions: The Store overview is open in an isolated Lab session.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/ | Fetch the real response, replace one product name, and fulfil it.
expected_result: The modified name renders without changing server data.

title: Abort catalogue request
preconditions: The Store overview is open in an isolated Lab session.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/ | Abort /store/catalog from page.route.
expected_result: A visible request-failed state appears and controls remain usable.

title: Handle one-shot 500
preconditions: The Store overview is open in an isolated Lab session.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/ | Arm 500 and run the next catalogue request.
expected_result: STORE_SIMULATED_500 appears once; the following request succeeds.

title: Handle deterministic timeout
preconditions: The Store overview is open in an isolated Lab session.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/ | Arm timeout and run the next catalogue request.
expected_result: The frontend shows REQUEST_TIMEOUT after its bounded client wait.

title: Handle malformed JSON
preconditions: The Store overview is open in an isolated Lab session.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/ | Arm malformed and run the next catalogue request.
expected_result: MALFORMED_JSON appears without an uncaught page error.

title: Handle empty array
preconditions: The Store overview is open in an isolated Lab session.
steps: Open /practice/apps/ecommerce/ | Arm empty and run the next catalogue request.
expected_result: The UI renders its explicit EMPTY_ARRAY state.
